limits: Name-based resolution: no type checker, shadowing is ignored.
Dynamic imports, reflection, directory scans and string-keyed registries are invisible.
Textual conflicts are only checked between changes that touch a common path (rename and directory conflicts are not detected until the combined merge).
Pairs with no recorded interaction are 'no evidence found', never 'proven compatible'.
